paper_title: Constraints on dark photon dark matter from Lyman-alpha forest simulations and an ultra-high signal-to-noise quasar spectrum
notes: Headline limit is Fig. 7 (Bounds_arrows.pdf in e-print), the blue 'This work' 95% CL upper limits on the dark photon kinetic mixing epsilon (=chi in the compilation convention; Eq.1 Lagrangian term -(epsilon/2)F^{munu}F'_{munu}) at fixed A' DM mass, from the transformed-flux tPDF analysis of the VLT/UVES spectrum of HE0940-1050 at z~2.7. Limits exist only at the 4 discrete simulation-grid masses log(m_A'/eV c^-2) = -13.15, -12.90, -12.65, -12.40; the paper states it does not reach 95% CL for lower (<=-13.4) or higher (>=-12.15) masses, so those are unconstrained. Extracted the cap (top horizontal bar) of each downward-pointing arrow, which is the upper-limit value (excluded region is above). Vector extraction; masses recovered land exactly on the stated grid, confirming calibration. Cosmological Lyman-alpha analysis assuming 100% of DM is dark photons; limit depends on cosmological mean DM density (not a local halo density), so dm_density_assumed = null. Reported chi = epsilon directly (no rescaling). Best-fit model of Ref.[41] (m_A'=8e-14 eV, epsilon=5e-15) is allowed at 95% CL by these bounds.
